title: Senator Bill Hagerty: Expanding the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, & the Future of Dollar Hegemony
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Senator Bill Hagerty: Expanding the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, & the Future of Dollar Hegemony Sen. Bill Hagerty explains why CBDCs threaten freedom, how regulatory ambiguity enabled SEC overreach, and what Congress can accomplish before January. This post Senator Bill Hagerty: Expanding the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, & the Future of Dollar Hegemony first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
